The '''Outer Depths''' was one of the three main caves in the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and the Outer Depths linked the eastern end of the [[Maximum Security thoroughfare]] to the [[Power Center cavern]]. The Depths also contained a large number of [[Esh-kha]] [[Prison|stasis]] pods as well as [[Maximum Security Block J-9]], and after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|attack]] on Belsavis the cavern became overrun with Esh-kha.
